title: Path independence of inertia invariants
statement: Let $C_0/k_0$ be a curve in the sense of [d-real-setup], let $j:U_0\hookrightarrow C_0$ be a nonempty open with finite complement $S_0$, and let $s\in S_0$. Let $\mathcal F$ be a lisse Weil $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$-sheaf on $U_0$, choose a geometric base point $\bar u$ on $U=U_0\times_{k_0}k$, and let $\rho:W(U_0,\bar u)\to\operatorname{GL}(V)$, where $V=\mathcal F_{\bar u}$, be its Weil fundamental representation of [def-wf-fundamental-representation]. Let $D_s$, $I_s$, $W(K_s)$ and the path-dependent decomposition homomorphisms $\theta_1,\theta_2$ be as in [lem-real-boundary-decomposition-landing], obtained from two choices of path from the same local geometric point to $\bar u$. For $a=1,2$, let $V_{s,a}$ be the space $V$ equipped with the $W(K_s)$-action $\rho\circ\theta_a|_{W(K_s)}$, and define $V_{s,a}^{I_s}=\{v\in V:\rho(\theta_a(i))v=v\text{ for every }i\in I_s\}$. These are equivalently the invariants under the subgroup $\theta_a(I_s)\subset W(U_0,\bar u)$ of [def-real-weil-representation-operations]. For a residue geometric Frobenius lift $\Phi\in W(K_s)$, let $T_a$ be the restriction of $\rho(\theta_a(\Phi))$ to $V_{s,a}^{I_s}$; this is a well-defined automorphism independent of the lift by [lem-real-boundary-frobenius-invariants], applied to the normal subgroup $I_s$ of $W(K_s)$. Then there is a linear isomorphism $A:V_{s,1}^{I_s}\xrightarrow{\sim}V_{s,2}^{I_s}$ with $A T_1=T_2 A$.
